title: Petition of the City of Chicopee for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of its borrowing by the issue of revenue bonds, and notes in anticipation thereof, pursuant to Chapter 164A of the G.L. at one time or from time to time in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $24,000,000 for refunding its $16,000,000 electric system revenue bonds, series of 1978 and $8,000,000 Electric System Revenue Bonds, Series of 1983 and for a portion of its share of project costs of the electric power facility known as Millstone No. 3.
